scientific_integrity: The automorphism-group formula, tangent-space dimension, and exact finite-field orders are supported by the displayed symbolic argument; finite checks and previous work are individually distinguished.
scientific_limitations: The classification assumes characteristic different from two and invertible bipartition sizes; balanced graphs give individual Ramanujan algebras over C but not a bounded-degree Ramanujan expander family. No assertion for characteristic two, singular sizes, or all Ramanujan evolution algebras. Absolute historical priority is not certified. Finite checks only corroborate the proof.
title: Orthogonal automorphisms and a characteristic-three infinitesimal defect for complete-bipartite evolution algebras
